title: Utility library: repeat, clamp, isBlank
prompt:
Implement three small utilities in one Solution class:

1. `static String repeat(String s, int n)` — returns s repeated n times (`repeat("ab", 3)` is `"ababab"`; n <= 0 gives `""`).
2. `static int clamp(int v, int min, int max)` — v if in range, otherwise the nearest bound.
3. `static boolean isBlank(String s)` — true for null, empty, or whitespace-only strings.

tests.name: repeat
tests.hint: Accumulate with StringBuilder or a loop; n <= 0 is the empty string.

tests.name: clamp
tests.hint: Two comparisons, two returns — or Math.max/min composed.

tests.name: isBlank
tests.hint: Handle null FIRST, then trim/strip and check emptiness.
